items.title: A context requirement inside a trait's DEFAULT method is charged to every call of the method, even calls that take the arm that needs no context
items.kind: bug (checker; context requirements and trait defaults)
items.discussion: met by lane ui-p3: with `MaybeSignal`, every static `.gap(dp(8))` on a `std::ui` element would have needed an ambient owner, so the lane added a second trait `Bindable<T>` whose signal arm lets a binding with no owner belong to its source
items.body: Fix the checker so the requirement follows the implementation that needs it, then decide whether `std::ui` returns to `MaybeSignal` (one value-or-signal trait across both UIs) or keeps `Bindable` for its owner-optional rule. Owner decision either way. Pin the multi-impl, default-method and generic forms.

items.title: `std::ui`: a handler that captures its own element makes a reference cycle, so the element lives until the program ends
items.discussion: reported by lane ui-p3 as a known leak; the element holds the handler closure, the closure holds the element's handle
items.body: Options: handlers hold a weak handle to their own element; removing an element from the tree drops its handlers; or the host breaks cycles when a subtree is detached. Pin with a drop counter in the gfx crate's tests, and add a row to the leak gate if native UI programs enter it.

items.title: The xvfb end-to-end tests can leave their program running: a `list --smoke` under `xvfb-run` was found alive 73 minutes after lane ui-p3's runs
items.discussion: `crates/vilan-cli/tests/{gfx_window,ui_screen,ui_interaction}.rs` start a program under `xvfb-run`; when a test panics or is killed between start and exit the child is not reaped
items.body: Give `Running` a `Drop` that kills the child's process group (xvfb-run, Xvfb and the program), and start it in its own group. Pin: a test that panics after `start` leaves no process.
